# Disclosure

`ui.disclosure` · parts: `Disclosure`, `Summary` · elements: `<details>`, `<summary>`

## Purpose

Disclosure is native details/summary. `name` groups exclusive accordions.

## Disclosure

Disclosure renders a native details element.

### Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Open` | `open` | `open` | `boolean` | — | prop | initial open state |
| `Name` | `name` | `name` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in UI frameworks, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

### Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

### Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

### ARIA

- No ARIA attributes are rendered by the primitive; rely on native semantics. Pass extra `aria-*` through attrs.

### Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `disclosureClasses({ ... })` from `disclosure/disclosure.shared.ts` |
| templ | `disclosure.DisclosureClasses(disclosure.DisclosureProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('disclosureClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::disclosureClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `disclosure_classes(p)` |

### Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<details>Content</details>` |
| open | `{"Open":true,"Name":"faq"}` | `<details open name="faq">Content</details>` |
| Open | `{"Open":true}` | `<details open>Content</details>` |

### Usage

Fixture `open` (`{"Open":true,"Name":"faq"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<details open name="faq">Content</details>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Disclosure } from "./ui/disclosure/disclosure";

<Disclosure open name="faq">Content</Disclosure>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Disclosure from "./ui/disclosure/Disclosure.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Disclosure open name="faq">Content</Disclosure>
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Disclosure from "./ui/disclosure/Disclosure.svelte";
</script>

<Disclosure open={true} name="faq">Content</Disclosure>
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Disclosure } from "./ui/disclosure/disclosure.solid";

<Disclosure open name="faq">Content</Disclosure>
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderDisclosure } from "./ui/disclosure/disclosure.wc";

document.body.append(renderDisclosure({ open: true, name: "faq" }, "Content"));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ
import "github.com/ui8kit/codegen/generated/templ/ui/disclosure"

@disclosure.Disclosure(disclosure.DisclosureProps{Open: true, Name: "faq"}) {
	Content
}
```

**Twig** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/twig.md))

```twig
{% include 'disclosure/Disclosure.html.twig' with { open: true, name: 'faq', children: 'Content' } only %}
```

**Latte** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/latte.md))

```latte
{include 'disclosure/Disclosure.latte', open: true, name: 'faq', children: 'Content'}
```

**Jinja2** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/jinja2.md))

```jinja
{% with p = {'Open': True, 'Name': 'faq'}, children = 'Content' %}{% include 'ui/disclosure/disclosure.html.j2' %}{% endwith %}
```
